_comment: Issue #92 R2: the combat-hotbar consumable-toggle + real combat item-use canonical. Loads item_use_loop_start (post_tutorial's exact twin + a carried mending_draught, the R1 heal-shaped item -- no vendor wires it yet, R5's job; this fixture grants it directly). Opens the inventory panel and confirms the mending_draught row: R2's own 'journal toggle mirrors skill toggling' -- this TOGGLES its combat-hotbar loadout membership (item:mending_draught appended to the shared hotbar_loadout, the SAME LOADOUT_CHANGED event journal.gd's skill toggle emits) rather than trying to equip it, and the row's own '[On Hotbar]' tag renders. Toggling the item does NOT blank the un-curated Warrior kit (power_strike stays AUTO-visible -- item tokens are filtered out of the array fed to the skill side's own apply_loadout, see combat_hud.gd's rebuild_slots doc comment) -- the SAME deterministic walk to goblin_encounter_2 combat_move_input.json already proves out (identical fixture position/rng_state) now renders a 5th hotbar slot: Attack(1)/Dash(2)/[Power Strike](3)/Mending Draught(4)/End Turn. Selecting slot 4 arms the SAME no-target confirm gate Dash uses (Mode.DASH_CONFIRM, generalized); confirming spends exactly 1 AP (flat, independent of any per-item field), fires WIGame.combat_use_item, erases the item from inventory (consumption = inventory.erase, items never stack -- a genuine repeatable sink once R5 wires a vendor to it), and emits item_used + a toast (the mandated visible card). The PC is at full HP at turn start (no prior damage this fight), so the heal clamps to 0 -- a deliberate simplification (tests/test_combat_sim.gd's c119 block already pins the nonzero-heal/clamp/AP-refusal arithmetic against hand-built dicts); this script's own job is proving the REAL wiring end-to-end, not re-deriving numbers a unit test already owns. Ends mid-combat on purpose, mirroring combat_move_input.json's own precedent -- no victory assert needed.
